subject: NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp
message: File timestamp API (NSFileModificationDate, modificationDate) is called 2 times in 2 files, first here, and no PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy declares NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp
fix: Add an NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes entry for NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryFileTimestamp with the reason that matches the use. Apple lists: DDA9.1, C617.1, 3B52.1, 0A2A.1

subject: NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace
message: Disk space (NSPrivacyAccessedAPICategoryDiskSpace) is declared, and no scanned code calls it
fix: Remove the entry if no code or linked SDK in this target calls the API; keep it if the call is in code this scan does not read (a precompiled library, another language)
